caption: The drawing depicts a single lantern rendered in shades of gray and black on a plain, light-colored background. The lantern has a rectangular body with four vertical glass panels, reinforced by thin vertical and horizontal metal bars at the corners and seams. The top section of the lantern is cylindrical, with a series of small openings, including round and heart-shaped holes, for ventilation. A circular, slightly domed lid sits atop this section, surmounted by a rounded metal handle attached on each side. The base of the lantern is square, with a slight protrusion along its bottom edge. The overall drawing uses detailed shading to convey the metallic texture and transparent quality of the glass panels, as well as the cylindrical candle holder inside the lantern. The artist’s name, "Henry Granet," is written in small text in the bottom left corner.
title: Lantern for Candle
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
